items.question: What cure period applies to a material breach of the warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The cure period for a material breach of the warehouse lease is thirty (30) days. This is stated in source 1, which says: "Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately on written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice" [1].

No other source addresses a cure period for a material breach of the warehouse lease.
